9-panel cinematic storyboard sheet derived from Image 1. Mix Wide, Medium, and Tight shots of the same scene. No borders between panels.

Layout: 3x3 grid (9 panels) in a 16:9 landscape image.

Scene: Locked overhead flat-lay shot, camera directly above looking straight down, modern social-first product photography with tactile editorial energy, 16:9 frame. A folded crisp white cotton towel fills the center of the frame, laid on a pale laminate folding table in a cramped Bondi share-house laundry room. Arranged on the towel in a curated but lived-in spread: the lipstick from (CORAL_LIPSTICK (Image 4)) resting near the middle, a small ring of kiosk keys, a stubby tub of zinc-white sunscreen with a smear across its lid, a half-eaten frozen pineapple stick beading condensation into a small dark damp patch on the cotton, and a thin elastic hair tie curled loose. SCARLETT's hand enters from the right edge of frame — she wears a pale white kiosk uniform polo with loose collar, sleeve just visible at the wrist — fingers spread and tensed a breath above the keys, about to pluck them, the towel already beginning to pucker under her palm, the lipstick caught mid-roll a fraction of a turn out of place. Around the edges of the frame the environment bleeds in: square white ceramic wall tiles, torn cardboard mailer flap and crumpled cream tissue paper pushed to one corner, the top edge of a front-load dryer, a coiled cable. Hard directional morning sunlight through aluminium louvre window slats lays clean parallel stripes of gold-white light and crisp shadow across the towel and the objects, punched with a soft circular ring-light fill that lifts the shadows and throws a faint round catchlight on the glossy surfaces and a bright specular flare along the metal band. Bright high-key exposure, true-to-life color, crisp whites, warm highlights, lifted airy shadows, one coral accent popping against neutrals. Shot on a 35mm macro-capable prime, shallow-ish depth of field with the center razor sharp and the table edges softening, fine cotton weave and condensation droplet detail, clean digital capture with subtle film grain.

Every panel is a shot of the same scene as Image 1 — keep the characters, wardrobe, lighting, color grade, and texture consistent across all panels.
